title: Sluggish PH consumer spending seen to continue in 2027

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Weak consumer confidence is expected to continue weighing on household consumption next year, with mounting headwinds and an uncertain macroeconomic environment likely to limit the pace of spending growth, according to a think tank. In a commentary, BMI, a unit of Fitch Solutions, said household spending may grow 2.8 percent in 2027. […]... Keep on reading: Sluggish PH consumer spending seen to continue in 2027
